stories.title: Growing concerns for missing teenage boys in Corwen
stories.summary: A police appeal has been launched amid growing concerns for two young boys missing from the Corwen area. 14-year-old Bobby (left) and 15-year-old Thomas (right) went missing at around 9pm on 31 May. stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has told planning inspectors that Uniper’s proposed new power station at Connah’s Quay would be a dominant visual feature in the surrounding landscape for up to 2.5km. stories.title: Two new industrial units approved at Rhydymwyn estate where fire destroyed building in 2022
stories.summary: A planning officer at Flintshire County Council has approved two industrial units at Antelope Industrial Estate on Denbigh Road, Rhydymwyn, three years after a fire destroyed the site’s largest building. stories.title: Coleg Cambria lecturer returns to hero’s welcome after Hawkstone Farmers Choir wins Britain’s Got Talent
stories.summary: A Coleg Cambria lecturer received a hero’s welcome from students and staff after helping make television history as part of the first choir ever to win Britain’s Got Talent (BGT).
